name: Vergessia Rhamphorhynchus
original_name: バージェシア・ランフォリンクス
source:
"What do you want? Dismantling? Surgery? Or remodeling?"

He came to the academy this fall. He doubles as a biology teacher and a substitute school nurse because the regular nurse is on maternity leave.

Although he has long hair and speaks like a woman, he's a true man in both body and soul. He is sarcastic and prideful, but is on bad terms with [url=https://vndb.org/c43559]Phor[/url]. 

He uses his role as a substitute nurse to bring various tools to work with him. At night, he devotes himself to his research hobby.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111116203650/http://senz.jp/chara/chara5.html]official website[/url]]
